the presence of α-Al  2 O  3 particles in cobalt–nickel sulfamate electrolytes can enhance the codeposited Co and reduce the charge-transfer resistance of Co–Ni electrodeposition process, and the effect of α-Al2  2 O   3 particles on codeposited Co is related to Co 2+ adsorption on Al  2 O    3 particles surface.
the presence of α-Al  particles in Co–Ni electrolytes can promote the preferential codeposited Co, which is beneficial to the preparation of Co–Ni/α-Al  composites.

the effect of α-Al2 O3 particles on electrocodeposition of Co– Ni alloys in sulfamate electrolyte is quite different at different Co2+ /Ni2+ ratio, which is mainly due to the different electrochemical codeposition mechanisms of Al 2O3 particles in Co2+-rich and Ni2+-rich electrolytes.

the effect of Al2O3 particles in Co-Ni sulfamate electrolytes on the electrochemical behaviour of Co– Ni alloy matrix, which will be helpful to understand the electrochemical codepositon of Co-Ni alloy matrix with ceramic particles.
the electrochemical codeposited behaviour of Co–Al2O3 and Ni–Al 2 O 4 particles in Co–Al 2O 3 and Ni– Al 2 O3 particles containing Co–Ni alloys.
the effect of Al2O3 on the electrochemical behavior of Co–Ni sulfamates electrolyte and the mechanism of codeposited Al2O3 with Co–Ni alloy.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the presence of α-Al 3+ O 3 particles has a significant effect on the electrochemical behavior of Co–Ni sulfamates electrolytes.
the Al 2O 3 particles have a strong influence on the electrochemical behaviour and codeposition of Co and Ni in Co–Ni alloys.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the electrochemical codepositon behaviour of Al 2O 3 particles with Ni–Co alloy matrix is affected by Co 2+ and Ni 2+ concentrations, and the codepositon mechanism of Al ₂O₃ particles is different in nickel-rich and cobalt-rich electrolyte.
the electrochemical codeposited Al 2 O3 particles in Co-Ni alloys from sulfamate bath is mainly controlled by the adsorption of Co2+ ions on Al2O3 particles surface.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the electrochemical codepositon of Al 2O 3 particles with cobalt-nickel alloys is a promising way to produce Al 2O3 reinforced Co–Ni composites with a high content of Al 2 3 particles.
the electrochemical codeposited Al 2 O3 particles can be used as a new kind of electrocatalysts for the electrochemical reduction of oxygen in alkaline media.
the presence of α-Al ₂O₃ particles in Co– Ni sulfamate electrolytes is able to control the codeposition behavior of Co and Ni.
